assets.name: dataset/rat_field
assets.kind: hand-labeled YOLO dataset for whole-field CH01-CH04 (built via the active-learning loop)
assets.note: NOT in git and NOT regeneratable — the label budget is the expensive input. round_provenance.csv records which round each frame entered. Mirror to Cornell storage so stage-data.ps1 can stage it to /workdir.

assets.name: runs/detect/rat_field/weights/best.pt
assets.note: Regeneratable from dataset/rat_field via train_detector.py --data-root dataset/rat_field --name rat_field. Fetched back from BioHPC with fetch-results.ps1 -Archive after a server retrain.

embedding_model.resolved: DINOv3 ViT-B/16 (dinov3_vitb16_pretrain_lvd1689m, sha256_16 73cec8be7427c865, dim 768) when the license-gated checkpoint is present; else DINOv2 ViT-S/14 (free). Reduced by numpy PCA; gray64+PCA is the CPU/self-test fallback.
embedding_model.note: Fingerprint (family/variant/weights sha256) travels in each run's measurement_context detector.embedding block.

current_state.dataset_local_path: cv/dataset/rat_field (git-ignored); 78 labeled over 2 rounds (67 with rats, 154 boxes)
current_state.round0: 2026-06-28 night, CH03/CH04, 40 frames from a 323-frame pool (DINOv3 ViT-B/16 diversity, K=3)
current_state.round1: same night, +40 uncertainty x diversity frames (seed = rat_field_stab), excluding round-0's 40
current_state.fair_head_to_head: same 15 held-out frames / 29 boxes (both models held these sessions out): round0@40 mAP50 0.715 / mAP50-95 0.354 / P 0.656 / R 0.724; round1@80 mAP50 0.726 / mAP50-95 0.424 / P 0.758 / R 0.655. Within noise; +labels helped precision/localization, not recall.
current_state.next: more NIGHTS (new scenes) > more frames from one night; pin a fixed held-out + run --method random control for a rigorous label-efficiency curve

note: Large / non-regeneratable cv_field assets live off-repo under the artifact root; this file is the in-repo pointer. Separate from cv/assets_manifest.json so cv_shelter assets are untouched.
